title: Why every startup is pivoting to AI agents in 2026

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: By 2026, AI agents will be the core of every startup due to their ability to automate complex workflows with minimal human input.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Not every startup can afford the infrastructure or data needed to train effective AI agents—many will fail before they even launch.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Open-source frameworks like LLaMA and MPT reduce costs, while protocols like LangChain enable rapid integration and scaling.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Even with these tools, most startups lack the technical depth to implement AI agents without major pivots or external help.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: The future belongs to those who pivot early—AI agents are the new infrastructure, and startups are already building on it.
